messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: multiple nodes entering NotReady in cluster 'us-west-2-prod' affecting nodepool 'inference-pool-usw'. 5 nodes NotReady within 3m, kubelet restarted on several hosts. autopagerduty triggered.
anya: acked. I'm on call, looking. Which customers are hitting errors?
sam: i'm waking up, taking over if needed. joining now.
leo: seeing elevated 5xxs on hosted API metrics, also some Dedicated customers reporting elevated latencies. Spike started ~3m ago.
anya: getting logs from node-ig-7q2 and node-ig-9f4. journalctl shows repeated kubelet restarts: "kubelet: segfault" then systemd restart.
diana: we should assess customer impact before mass changes. mohit, can you open a status update draft?
mohit: on it. drafting: "We are investigating increased errors for inference endpoints in us-west-2, potential node restarts affecting capacity." will post once we confirm impact.
anya: running quick checks: 
```
kubectl get nodes -l pool=inference-pool-usw -o wide
kubectl describe node node-ig-7q2
journalctl -u kubelet -n 200 | tail -n 80
```
leo: added extracted journal snippet — kubelet OOM-ish backtrace: "runtime: out of memory" then segfault in cgroup manager. Also dmesg shows "oom_kill" for process /usr/bin/containerd on a few nodes.
infra-bot: GPU node health probe: node-ig-7q2: nvidia-smi: failed to initialize NVML: Driver/library version mismatch; node-ig-9f4: NVML initialization timed out.
sam: suspecting recent driver/kernel combo. Did we push any node-driver updates in the last 6h?
anya: there was an automated package update window at 02:30 UTC — some images were rotated with new kernel+driver. Ops scheduled minor kernel patch on a subset of nodes.
leo: that would explain NVML errors and containerd OOMs if kernels mismatched. we should stop scheduling new pods to affected nodes.
anya: plan: cordon the NotReady/unstable nodes, drain what we can gracefully, scale up spare capacity in the pool (increase ASG desired by +3), and fail traffic to healthy regions where possible. also enable fallback to CPU variant for small models if GPU nodes are exhausted.
sam: agree. who will run the cordon/drain? I'll take it. anya, can you patch autoscaler?
anya: doing cordon now: `kubectl cordon node-ig-7q2` then drain with --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force for pods that are stuck.
```
kubectl cordon node-ig-7q2 && kubectl drain node-ig-7q2 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force
```
leo: be careful when draining inference pods — some are heavy KV-cache-backed; we should evict lower-priority jobs first. using nodeSelector/tolerations to prioritize.
sam: starting drains on node-ig-7q2 and node-ig-9f4. moving low-priority batch jobs to spare nodes.
anya: upping ASG desired count by 3 to create fresh nodes with pinned older driver image: `aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group-name inf-pool-usw --desired-capacity 18` (was 15).
mohit: statuspage: posted initial update: "Investigating node restarts causing degraded inference capacity in us-west-2. Some customers may experience increased latency and 5xxs. We will post updates every 15 minutes."
diana: alerting support owners: please tag any dedicated accounts affected.
leo: quick mitigation idea: apply emergency taint to affected nodes to stop scheduling and let existing pods die; also increase fallback routing weight to cpu-variants in traffic router.
anya: applied taint: `kubectl taint nodes node-ig-7q2 node.kubernetes.io/unavailable=true:NoSchedule`
sam: drains completed for two nodes; observed that containerd restart occurs mid-eviction on one node — had to delete stuck pod. logs show container runtime died with message: "containerd: runtime didn't respond: EOF".
infra-bot: detected 3 more nodes reporting NVML errors after cordon.
leo: rolling rollback option: revert the kernel/package change via image rotation or stop node upgrades. but that is slow. better to bring up fresh nodes with known-good AMI and migrate pods.
anya: agreed. provisioning fresh instances with AMI `ami-redwood-infer-v20250321` (last-known-good). kubectl will join after cloud-init; patching autoscaler config to prefer that AMI.
sam: also enabling traffic failover: increase route weight to us-east healthy cluster for non-enterprise traffic by 80%. enterprise customers (Dedicated/reserved) keep local if capacity exists — must notify Sales/CS.
diana: sending targeted messages to account owners for 3 Dedicated customers showing elevated errors.
mohit: posted second status update — we've initiated mitigation, scaling up healthy nodes, and routing to healthy region. ETA for capacity restoration ~10-20m.
leo: note — some pods logged CUDA error: "CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_INSTRUCTION" before node died. that might be NV driver mismatch causing runtime aborts that then trigger containerd instability.
anya: can someone run `kubectl logs --previous` on a crashed inference pod and paste snippet?
sam: pasted logs from pod inference-xyz (previous container):
```
E tensorflow: failed to initialize gpu device 0: CUDA_ERROR_UNKNOWN: unknown error
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::runtime_error'
Aborted (core dumped)
```
leo: that aligns with driver/api mismatch. we should avoid scheduling GPU workloads onto nodes until NVML stable.
anya: I've flagged the nodepool as degraded and set autoscaler min to ensure we don't scale to zero. also created a temporary scaling policy to prefer fresh AMI nodes.
sam: rolling traffic migration working, error rate for hosted endpoints dropping from 18% to 6% as new nodes come up and failover completes. still seeing some retries.
mohit: status update 3: "Mitigations in progress: affected nodes cordoned/drained, fresh nodes provisioning with tested AMI, traffic partially routed to healthy region. Some customers impacted; engineering investigating cause." Will include ETA.
diana: decision log: do we want to engage infra on call for kernel/driver investigation or keep this as oncall ops until nodes stabilize?
leo: escalate to infra team — their kernel/drivers group needs to verify the automated update pipeline. tagging infra on next message.
anya: escalating: @infra-team please investigate kernel/driver rollout that coincided with node restarts.
infra-bot: infra-team oncall paged.
sam: handing over active mitigation to infra oncall after 30m window. @anya please take post-incident followup and draft the postmortem (action owner). I'll remain in thread for 1hr for rollback help.
anya: taking ownership for postmortem and followups. creating incident ticket INC-2026-1987 and will add timeline + logs.
leo: quick notes to add to incident ticket: suspect kernel-driver mismatch, NVML init failures, containerd OOMs, cascading kubelet restarts, mitigation: cordon/drain, ASG scale-up, AMI revert, traffic failover.
mohit: posted final short status: "Errors reduced, cluster capacity recovering. We're continuing to monitor; next update in 30 minutes or when resolved."
anya: final oncall handoff: i'm primary incident owner for postmortem and customer comms. sam taking on immediate infra support for 60m. passing to the normal rotation after that.
leo: reminder to open a telemetry eval to surface similar driver/kernel mismatches via our agent in future — add alert on NVML errors + kubelet restarts correlated.
anya: creating follow-up tasks: tag: postmortem, fix-auto-upgrade, pin-driver-ami, alerting-rule.
incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED: degraded capacity resolved in inference-pool-usw; nodes recovered and replaced. follow-up tasks created.
anya: thanks team. I'll sync with infra and ops to prevent recurring auto-upgrades mid-traffic windows.
